model.name: Companies as shared scenario units
model.description: Each company is an ior:class:Company scenario unit; multiple profiles reference the SAME company unit (dedup by name) with no duplication, making Company a first-class shared entity in the object graph.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "ior:class:Company. Multiple profiles reference SAME company unit, no duplication. Company is first-class entity in object graph."
